item.title: Connacht Electoral Divisions 2019 source files
item.subtitle: Electoral Divisions / Tailte Eireann, Phelim Birch
item.description: Connacht electoral divisions for 2019. Per the IDB boundary-change log, Connacht ED boundaries were unchanged from the 1986 redrawing (when the Galway county borough was established) through to 2019, so this file is the same as the 1986 dataset.
